facebookresearch_rlstructures/tutorial/d.update_ReinforceAgent: update the ReinforceAgent model weights by loading a new state dict
facebookresearch_rlstructures/tutorial/d.build_AgentModel: build an AgentModel neural network that outputs action probabilities from observation frames
facebookresearch_rlstructures/tutorial/d.build_BaselineModel: build a BaselineModel neural network that computes state value V(s) for critic

facebookresearch_rlstructures/tutorial/d.run_Experiment: run a REINFORCE reinforcement learning experiment with CartPole-v0 using multiprocessing
facebookresearch_rlstructures/tutorial/d.review_Experiment_class: review the Experiment class that extends Reinforce for reinforcement learning training

facebookresearch_rlstructures/tutorial/d.run_REINFORCE_training: run the Reinforce class to train an RL agent using policy gradient with baseline and entropy regularization

facebookresearch_rlstructures/tutorial/d.compute_get_loss: compute the REINFORCE loss including baseline loss, reinforce loss, and entropy loss from sampled trajectories
facebookresearch_rlstructures/tutorial/d.review_REINFORCE_run_loop: review the Reinforce run method training loop that samples trajectories, computes loss, and updates model weights
facebookresearch_rlstructures/tutorial/d.refactor_get_loss_cumulative_reward: refactor the get_loss method to vectorize the cumulative discounted reward computation instead of using a for loop
